Elderly Man Missing After Falling Into Open Stormwater Drain

A 70-year-old man has been missing for over 40 hours after falling into an open stormwater drain in Miyapur. The incident occurred when the man was swept away by the water flow. Rescue efforts are ongoing to locate him.
